# Deep learning (LeCun, Bengio, Hinton)

Review paper, useful as the map of the field to cite in a thesis introduction.

- Three ingredients: many layers, backpropagation, and enough data and compute.
- Frames the shift from hand-designed features to learned representations.
- Sections on convolutional nets, recurrent nets, and why depth helps in principle.

The section on distributed representations is the clearest short account of why learned
features generalise; I quote it in the introduction rather than the original papers.
